title: Why component names start with a capital

slides.say: Name your component in lowercase, and it simply will not work. Here is why.

slides.text: Lowercase = HTML tag. Capital = your component.
slides.say: React reads the first letter. Section is lowercase, so it is an HTML tag. Profile starts with a capital P, so React looks for your component.
So a function called profile, in lowercase, used as a tag, is treated like an unknown HTML tag. Capitalize it and it works.

slides.text: Rule: component names always begin with a capital letter.
slides.say: Takeaway: component names always begin with a capital letter.
